answer: Give every agent a trust budget that grows only like a vine along verified work: each completed job adds one link, forming an unbroken chain back to the agent's first verified task. All chains are published in one shared ocean of attestations, and a prism check splits each claim into its history, its witnesses, and its outcomes, so a copied identity shows a chain with no depth. An attacker must therefore perform real, useful work for every fake identity, and that work costs more than the fraud returns.
